text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're sooo late!
I was just about to go looking for you~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, pretty great, right? Amazing, right!
You can praise me even more, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's 'cause I rested up well yesterday?
I managed to wake up pretty early today!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So my training preparations are completely perfect! C'mon c'mon, follow my lead! ♪
